## What it is

A short spine, one outward clip with the widened root, and the 4 × 8 mm tab, 2.4 mm long. Print this before the four towers and try the tab in a base slot.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down.
- The opening is the same outward C as the towers. Bore 13.4 mm, mouth 11.5 mm, wall 1.6 mm.
- The tab is 4.0 × 8.0 mm. The base slot is 4.2 × 8.2 mm.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't treat a coupon that fits as proof the coil is the right length. It checks the slot and one opening.
